topics.title: Topics
topics.name: Topic name
topics.ruleHint: Optionally copy keywords, source and date filters from a smart view. No setup is needed by default. Automatic mode uses AI within this scope; manual mode retains individual source management.
topics.emptyTitle: Follow a topic, see what changed
topics.emptyHint: Choose what you want to follow. AI selects relevant local articles and produces highlights and reading recommendations. Generate an update when candidate material changes. Topics and history also work without AI.
topics.deleteHint: Delete this topic, its briefings and topic notes? Original articles, article notes, stars and smart views are kept.
topics.noDescription: Add a description to focus the comparison.
topics.scopeChanged: Scope differs from last successful briefing
topics.upToDate: No change since last successful briefing
topics.generateHint: Review the confirmed scope before generating. Uses the enabled summary model and its routing; see Settings → Tasks. Suggested scope: 5–20 articles. Up to 40 articles; complete available bodies are included. No whole-library fetching or background AI.
topics.missingHint: {{count}} sources have no usable body and will be recorded as unavailable, excluded from evidence. Fetch explicitly below; failures remain visible. Generation can use the remaining ready bodies.
topics.noSources: Select candidates below, or use Select articles in an article list.
topics.candidateHint: Search and smart-view matches are suggestions only. Check articles and add them explicitly. Already confirmed articles are hidden here; selections refer only to loaded pages.
topics.noCandidates: No new candidates on loaded pages.
topics.stale: This version was generated from a different source scope. Its excerpts remain available; refresh and generate to analyze current changes.
topics.citationLimit: References validate article identity and exact excerpt locations only. They do not prove that AI claims are correct. Check the evidence, conditions and independence yourself.
topics.frozenScope: Inspect this version's frozen source scope
topics.aiHint: You can manage topics without AI. Configure an enabled summary-compatible model under Settings, then explicitly generate.
topics.groupHint: Use the same label for republications; use different labels for independent evidence. Blank restores exact-body grouping. Near-duplicates still require review.
topics.notesHint: Your judgment and notes are saved separately from AI briefings. Regeneration never overwrites saved user notes. Markdown export includes the saved notes.
topics.currentMatch: This source still matches the frozen version. The highlight below shows its exact saved excerpt.
topics.oldSnapshot: This is a historical snapshot. The current source differs or is no longer included; opening today's article may not locate the same text. The saved excerpt is highlighted below.
topics.currentArticle: Current article · saved evidence remains in the topic
topics.noChanges: No effective changes. No AI request was sent.

phase.waiting: Waiting for the previous topic task…
phase.comparing: Comparing sources and writing the article…
phase.selecting: AI is selecting relevant articles and grouping reports…

progress.title: Briefing generation progress
progress.waitingHint: Waiting for the generation service to respond. Timing depends on the amount of material and service response. You can cancel at any time.

topics.simpleHint: Enter a topic such as “AI coding tools”. Uses local articles from your subscriptions; AI runs only when you generate.
topics.switchHint: Switching enables automatic discovery. Existing sources, rules, briefings and personal notes are retained.
topics.localCoverage: Local discovery: latest 1,000 articles, up to 1,000 topic matches across the allowed corpus, and retained sources. Checking {{scanned}} of {{total}} in scope. Up to 60 per batch; up to 3 batches per click when no information is found.
topics.lastChecked: Last source check: {{time}} (separate from briefing generation)
topics.noInformation: No worthwhile new information. This batch was checked; the successful briefing baseline is unchanged.
topics.batchCoverage: This batch checks {{count}} of {{pending}} candidates. Generate again to check the remainder.
topics.autoHint: One click searches locally, uses AI to select relevant and non-redundant reporting, then writes a briefing. Checks up to 3 batches when no information is found; generate again for remaining candidates. No background AI. Missing bodies are limited to titles and feed descriptions. Selection previews include the opening and topic-relevant passages, up to 1,000 characters, and can still miss details; selected articles use complete available bodies.
topics.metadataOnly: Title and feed description only; full article not read
topics.citationLimitShort: Saved excerpts can be inspected. A citation does not prove the AI’s statement. Feedback affects future selection; historical snapshots remain.
topics.autoSourcesHint: Generate a briefing to find and select articles automatically. You can also add sources manually below.
topics.noLocalArticles: There are no local articles in this scope. Add or sync subscriptions, or broaden source and date filters in advanced options.
topics.noInformationHint: Recheck selection retries sources not yet used in a briefing, without adding articles manually. You can also refine the topic, scope or sync more articles. Rechecking sends new AI requests.
topics.moreCandidates: Checked batches offered no new information; {{count}} candidates still await review. Generate again without adding articles manually.
topics.modelHint: Generation uses the summary task configuration in Settings.

note.saveFailed: Could not save the note. Your draft is kept; try saving again.
note.clickToAdd: Click "Add Note" to write your thoughts

summary.historicalConfiguration: Showing a saved summary generated with earlier AI settings. Use Summarize to generate with the current settings.
summary.autoWarning: Automatically sends article content to your configured AI provider and may incur costs. Generate missing summaries after a 1-second pause?

translation.restoredPartial: Partial translation restored. Translate again to complete the remaining paragraphs.
translation.partial: Partial translation: {{completed}}/{{total}} segments. Retry missing segments.
translation.all_failed: Translation failed: no segments completed. Retry translation.
translation.previousSuccess: This attempt was incomplete. Showing the previous complete translation.

tagging.clickToSuggest: Click "Suggest Tags" to let AI analyze this article, or type a tag manually.
tagging.configureBatch: Select a tagging model in Agents before starting. Manual and local suggestions work without AI.
tagging.largeConfirm: I confirm analyzing over 100 entries may take time and incur provider costs.
tagging.reviewRequired: No tags have been applied. Review each new proposal, then confirm applying all matched and kept suggestions.
tagging.applyResult: {{count}} assignments inserted · {{deleted}} deleted and {{changed}} changed entries skipped
tagging.libraryLocked: Complete or discard the batch review before maintaining the library.
tagging.mergePreview: Move all {{source}} associations into {{target}}, remove duplicates, and keep the former name and aliases.
tagging.noAiSuggestions: AI returned no tags. Try again or use manual/local suggestions.

entry.loadFailed: Could not load entries. Try again.
entry.selectFeedOrTag: Select a feed or tag to view entries
entry.selectFeed: Select a feed to view entries

readerPane.summaryFallback: Full article could not be retrieved. Showing the Feed summary or legacy Feed content; it may be incomplete.
readerPane.extractionFailed: Content extraction failed. The article may not be available in reader mode.

settings.title: AI Providers
settings.description: Configure OpenAI-compatible API endpoints for summaries, translations, and tagging.
settings.noProvidersHint: Add a provider like OpenAI, Anthropic, or any OpenAI-compatible API.
settings.apiKeyKeepEmpty: API Key (leave empty to keep current)
settings.selectProviderToManage: Select a provider to manage models
settings.profilesDescription: Configure which model each agent type uses, along with default options.
settings.customPromptsDescription: Upload custom YAML prompt templates for each agent type. Templates use {{key}} substitution and {{#key}}...{{/key}} conditional sections. Built-in defaults are used when no custom template is set.
settings.usingDefaultTemplate: Using built-in default template. Upload a .yaml file to customize.
settings.archiveProviderConfirm: Archive “{{name}}”? Related models will be archived: {{models}}. Credentials and history are retained.
settings.archiveModelConfirm: Archive “{{name}}”? History and agent references are retained; this model becomes unavailable for new tasks.
settings.restoreProviderNote: Creating a provider with the same URL and name restores the archived provider and its saved key if no new key is entered. Use a different name for a new account. Models must be restored separately.

feed.deleteConfirm: Delete this feed and all its entries?

opml.importDescription: Select an OPML file to import feeds from another RSS reader.
opml.exportDescription: Export your feed subscriptions to an OPML file.

app.subtitle: Select a feed and an entry to start reading

usage.title: Usage Statistics
usage.description: LLM token usage across all AI features.
usage.breakdownNote: Usage is tracked per LLM API request across Summary, Translation, and Tagging features. Token counts are reported directly by each model provider and reflect actual API consumption within the selected time window.
usage.requestScope: Each started AI HTTP attempt is counted, including fallback, retry, failure and cancellation. Connection tests are excluded.
usage.utcRange: UTC rolling interval: {{from}} ≤ request start < {{to}}. Daily buckets use UTC.
usage.persistenceError: {{count}} usage writes failed during this app session; this report may be incomplete.
usage.missingNote: {{count}} requests have missing or partial token data. Shown sums include only values the provider reported; missing values are not measured zeroes.
usage.legacyNote: {{count}} historical aggregate events ({{tokens}} previously recorded tokens) are retained separately. Their exact request count and token availability cannot be reconstructed.

readerSettings.title: Reader Settings
readerSettings.modeHint: Appearance applies to the app and reader. Reader style keeps your chosen font.

fontSettings.title: Font Settings
fontSettings.previewText: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.

agentTask.background: This task is running in the background
agentTask.waiting: Waiting for the previous task to finish…

digest.previewFailed: Could not load the digest preview.
digest.title: Export Digest
digest.savedOnly: Includes saved content only. No AI generation or network request is made.
digest.unsavedNote: Unsaved note edits are not included. Save your note before exporting.
digest.missing: Selected content is unavailable and will be omitted:
digest.cancelled: File selection cancelled. Nothing was written.
digest.selectionHint: Select a small set from this list. Paging and article actions are paused; changing filters exits selection.

natural.title: AI topic search
natural.recentScope: Searches only the newest 100 articles within the current filters. Older articles are outside this check.
natural.quickResults: {{count}} results: {{verified}} AI-verified relevant; {{pending}} preliminary keyword matches awaiting verification.
natural.quickEmpty: No matching results are currently visible. AI is still checking this scope and may find additional relevant articles.
natural.keywordPending: Preliminary keyword match · not yet AI-verified
natural.hint: Expand the topic into multilingual keywords and quickly show partial local matches within the newest 100 articles. More matched terms and title matches rank higher. AI then reads the material, adds verified results and removes irrelevant preliminary matches. Missing bodies use title/summary only; notes need explicit selection.

errors.configuration: Configure an enabled provider and summary model in Settings → AI Agents. Keyword search still works.
errors.metadata: Could not load filter options, or they changed during parsing. Retry the request.
errors.invalid: The model returned invalid conditions. Try rephrasing or use manual filters. Current conditions are unchanged.
errors.unsupported: Some conditions cannot be expressed by local search. Rephrase or use manual filters:
errors.unknownSource: Source not found. Use an existing source name or its exact feed URL:
errors.ambiguousSource: Several sources share that name. Specify one exact feed URL:
errors.unknownTag: Tag not found. Use a tag shown in the filter options:
errors.ambiguousTag: Tag name is ambiguous. Select the tag manually:
errors.provider: AI request failed or was rejected. Completed stages are saved; resume the check or use manual filters.
errors.cancelled: Request cancelled. Current conditions are unchanged.
errors.conflict: Topic and manual conditions conflict; adjust and retry:
errors.invalidJudgment: The model returned invalid relevance judgments. This batch was not applied; retry.
errors.storage: Could not save search judgments; retry.
errors.stale: Local content or read / starred states changed; check again.
errors.rateLimited: Provider rate limit reached. Progress is saved; resume later. No infinite retries.
errors.timeout: The request timed out. Completed stages are saved; resume later.

natural.draft: Input or manual conditions changed. The list still shows the previous results; submit to update.
natural.boundary: Hard filters apply before selecting the newest 100 articles. Preliminary keywords use OR matching, not AI-confirmed relevance. Results can grow or shrink during verification; sorting, paging and bulk actions use the displayed immutable snapshot. You can read while waiting; collapsing inputs keeps the check running, leaving pauses it, and cancel restores the previous results.
natural.cached: Reused verified stage caches without a model request.
natural.partialFailure: Only part of this check completed. Previous valid results remain; retry the unfinished work.
natural.cannotSave: AI results are a snapshot of this check and cannot yet be saved as a smart view. Ordinary condition views can still be saved.
natural.manualHint: These manual conditions apply on your next submission. Editing does not immediately replace current AI results.
natural.staleResults: Some articles in this result version changed. Evidence is bound to the scanned material; check again before a bulk operation.
natural.phase_titles: Screening titles within the newest 100 articles
natural.status_failed: Check failed; completed stages are saved
natural.routeHint: Partial keyword matches are allowed and ranked across deduplicated languages. AI can still discover other relevant articles within the 100-article scope.
natural.titleCoverage: Titles screened: {{checked}} / {{total}}; {{model}} used a title model judgment or its cache.
natural.titleFallback: AI title responses were unusable for {{count}} articles; retained for content checks without accepting or excluding them.
natural.deepCoverage: Awaiting deeper review {{pending}}; complete bodies checked {{full}}; title/summary-only matches {{summary}}; complete notes checked {{notes}}.
natural.finished: This frozen scope is processed. Articles added after the scan began wait for the next incremental search; later content changes are marked stale.
natural.noConfirmed: No relevant result was confirmed. Some articles lack material or changed; this does not establish that all are unrelated.
natural.noRelevant: No relevant result was confirmed in this frozen scope. Title/preview judgments can still miss articles.
natural.basis_summary_only: Title/summary evidence only; body not verified
natural.basis_title_only: Title evidence only; body not verified
natural.frozenAt: Scope frozen at {{time}}; relative dates use this time.
natural.dataDisclosure: Sends local titles, summaries and bodies to AI; notes need explicit selection.

search.title: Full-text search
search.dateHint: UTC dates, inclusive end date; undated articles use their arrival time. Last N days is a rolling window and combines with date limits.
search.excludeTitle: Title must contain none of the keywords
search.coverage: Searches local titles, Feed summaries, downloaded or Feed-provided bodies and saved notes. No automatic downloads or AI calls. Space-separated terms must all match; symbols are literal. The first search builds the local index.
search.coverageShort: Searches locally saved content. Bodies not yet downloaded are excluded. No AI required.
search.saveHint: Save these keywords, filters and sort order. Last N days remains relative. New articles and edited notes update matching results automatically.
search.deleteHint: Deleting a view keeps its articles, notes and tags.
search.saveFailed: Could not save or delete. Check for duplicate names and retry.
search.viewsEmpty: Set search conditions, then use the bookmark button to save a view.
search.viewsFailed: Could not load views. Click to retry
search.bulkHint: Mark all read: every match, including unloaded pages. Digest: only checked, loaded articles.
search.unsaved: Conditions changed; saved view has not been updated
search.queryLimit: Use at most 1000 characters and 24 space-separated terms.
search.invalidDays: Days must be an integer between 1 and 36500.
search.invalidDates: The end date must not precede the start date.
search.otherActionsHint: Rename keeps the saved conditions. Save as new creates a separate view.
